about: A mistakes-drill card saved before #426 with no hint field: its Hint is computed from the card's own position (concreteRead, then mistakeHint), never the generic 'Look for the most forcing or solid option' - a quiet card reads 'No tactic to spot here', a mating card names the mate. Graded by gate 98 (TC-R183a..b) at kunal761. NOT COVERED: Kunal's look on his phone; Kunal's real deck (the 15 Nov checker's probe covered 6501 generated cards).
